title: Summation polynomials and the discrete logarithm problem on elliptic curves
experiment_hook: Implement and test tiny-field Semaev relation predicates and relation-rate scans.
caution: Foundational proposal; practical success depends on solving hard polynomial systems or finding another relation-generation shortcut.

title: Index calculus for abelian varieties of small dimension and the elliptic curve discrete logarithm problem
experiment_hook: Compare LMFDB isogeny-class and descent-like structure against relation-harvesting behavior.
caution: Most relevant to small-degree extension fields, not ordinary prime-field curves such as P-256.

title: Improving the Complexity of Index Calculus Algorithms in Elliptic Curves over Binary Fields
experiment_hook: Borrow the point-decomposition framing and measure whether toy factor bases show exploitable structure.
caution: Binary-field and heuristic complexity setting; do not transfer claims directly to prime-field ECC.

title: Solving the Elliptic Curve Discrete Logarithm Problem Using Semaev Polynomials, Weil Descent and Grobner Basis Methods -- an Experimental Study
experiment_hook: Use as a template for negative-result reporting and explicit solver bottleneck measurements.
caution: Focused on characteristic-two experiments and heuristic assumptions.

title: Symmetrized summation polynomials: Using small order torsion points to speed up elliptic curve index calculus
experiment_hook: Scan toy reductions for torsion or symmetry features and compare relation rank/collision rates.
caution: Technique is structural inspiration; the AutoLab verifier still requires concrete checked relations.

title: On the First Fall Degree of Summation Polynomials
experiment_hook: Record degree-growth, rank, and elimination bottleneck diagnostics in Grobner-style toy probes.
caution: Complexity analysis is not by itself an attack; it guides what to measure.

title: Point Decomposition Problem in Binary Elliptic Curves
experiment_hook: Try auxiliary-variable or lower-degree encodings for tiny relation predicates and compare search cost.
caution: Binary-field point-decomposition work; use only as design inspiration for prime-field toy probes.

title: On the discrete logarithm problem for prime-field elliptic curves
experiment_hook: Use as the main prime-field Semaev baseline; compare one-basis or reduced-basis ideas against verifier targets.
caution: Prime-field relevance is high, but it is still not a practical attack on cryptographic curves.

title: A New Index Calculus Algorithm for the Elliptic Curve Discrete Logarithm Problem and Summation Polynomial Evaluation
experiment_hook: Drive low-weight combinatorial relation-harvesting probes and recursive summation-evaluation scans.
caution: The authors' complexity remains worse than Pollard rho for cryptographic prime curves.

title: A SAT-Based Approach for Index Calculus on Binary Elliptic Curves
experiment_hook: Translate the symmetry-breaking mindset into combinatorial relation searches over factor-base subsets.
caution: SAT model targets binary extension fields, but the search/constraint viewpoint can inspire prime-field toy experiments.
